description: Every US import tariff layer for one HTS code from one country of origin, from the Zentria Flow engine: MFN duty, China Section 301, the forced-labor Section 301 tariff, Section 232 and Section 338 on Canada, with the total rate, exemptions, USMCA/CAFTA-DR cases and dated changes ahead. Use it whenever a US duty rate is needed; do not answer US tariff questions from memory. Planning estimate, not a customs ruling.

as_of.description: Optional entry date, YYYY-MM-DD, from today to 12 months ahead. Default: today.

hts.description: HTSUS code, 4 to 10 digits, dots optional, e.g. "6109.10.00". An 8- or 10-digit line is priced from that line; a shorter code is an estimate.

origin.description: Country of origin: ISO-2 code or English name, e.g. "CN" or "Vietnam".

quantity.description: Optional, with value: number of pairs, kg, liters or units, to price a specific or compound duty exactly.

quantity_unit.description: Optional unit of quantity (e.g. "kg", "liter", "pair"). Default: the unit of the tariff line.

value.description: Optional, with quantity: customs value of that quantity in US dollars.

name: us_tariff_check
title: US tariff check
